title: axiom-cli linux-x64 release set manifest
description: Owner: axiom-cli. Task J-008. The release set is the unit the Linux x64 installer consumes. It is deliberately a LINE-ORIENTED document: each top-level scalar is one line, user_service is one object on one line, and each artifact entry is one object on one line. The POSIX-sh installer reads it with sed, so no JSON parser is required on the target host. packaging/linux/Build-ReleaseSet.sh is the only supported producer. The installer validates the recorded sha256 and size_bytes against the artifact bytes before anything is staged, so this manifest is a claim the installer verifies rather than trusts.

release_set_version.description: Shape version of this manifest, not the release version.

release_version.description: Distribution release the whole set belongs to. Must equal VERSION in the repository root.

platform.description: Installer platform profile. The Linux installer refuses any other value with exit 9 (incompatible) instead of misreading the set.

target_triple.description: Rust target triple the artifacts were built for.

libc.description: C library family the artifact links against. musl is not delivered by this tier.

user_service.description: Optional systemd-user unit declaration. Absent or null means the set declares no service. The installer registers it only when a user service manager answers; otherwise the service_registration block records the explicit degradation and the service is not registered.

artifacts.description: Every artifact this set carries. Each entry is one object on one line.

name.description: File name the artifact is installed as.

arch.description: Recorded per artifact so a mixed set cannot hide its own architecture.

archive.description: File name relative to the release set directory. Absolute paths and parent traversal are refused by the installer.
